assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is an intake-ready conceptual submission using provisional rough geometry. All area, ratio, location and implementation statements require recalculation and professional confirmation; no official boundary is present.

assumptions.statement: The receipt date, queue number, adverse-action isolation, and offline completion figures are synthetic tabletop assertions, not legal effects or observed service performance.
assumptions.impact: A professional and legal review must define the applicable procedure, authority, retention period, accessibility route, and emergency exception before any real pilot.

assumptions.statement: No real institution, public counter, claimant, case record, identity data, or operational channel is represented; provisional geometry is only a conceptual carrier.
assumptions.impact: Replace synthetic fixtures and provisional polygons with cleared, institution-approved evidence before implementation discussion.

assumptions.statement: The six international references in taskbook-deliverables.json link to first-party institutional pages and are used only as comparative mechanism prompts, not local evidence or confirmed partnerships.
assumptions.impact: A professional team must recheck access date, factual scope, licensing and transfer limits before using any case in a planning or implementation decision.

assumptions.statement: ARRIVED and HOLD_FOR_HUMAN are tabletop states, not legal receipt, deadline suspension, entitlement or acceptance decisions.
assumptions.impact: Any real pilot requires a competent receiving authority, applicable procedure, emergency exception, records schedule and independent review mandate.
